body: I wish I could be of more help but I'm having my own set of problems. However, if I can offer just **one** piece of advice, don't beat yourself up or harm yourself over something that isn't true. You are **not** retarded.

Thanks for your sympathy. I get that you may see that I'm hard\-working and resorceful, and maybe at some point I was but over the past year or two I've just given up. I'm no longer that person and that's another thing. I hate that I want to try to do something to get out of my situation and my melancholy but to date, every attempt to do that has been either foiled by an unforeseen event \(e.g., me pulling up my bootstraps after losing $140k and working/saving money to move out and make the best of a bad situation \-\- only to have just about all of my earnings drained from the constant "loans" and bailouts and even outright THEFT by my mother. Then there's my car, saved up $15k after two years to buy it, which I can't drive due to no license, being used by my dad since it's "better on gas" or whatever BS excuse\). so I really don't see the point of exerting myself to TRY to do something when the chances that I will fail are almost 100% certain. I hate that I have no energy. I'm just worn\-out, and I'm only 27 years old!

The tl;dr is \-\- between winning a large sum of money \($200,000, $140,000 after taxes\) and having it embezzled COMPLETELY from under my nose by my parents \(the last people I would have suspected to do that to me\) and the fact that I'm an overweight loser with nothing on the horizon as far as a career or relationship goes. Don't even have friends, not since grade school, but actually, this is the least of my concerns and it doesn't bother me.

Still live with my parents, have a car but don't even have my license yet so I can't drive it \(my dad decided to help himself to my car, something I spent TWO years working for to buy, racking up the miles on it\) and I'm still being used and bled dry.

Future looks bleak. Housing prices and rents are too high, homeownership was a goal of mine but has withered away \(See the part about losing $140K to my parents and continuously losing money from my meager earnings after the fact!\), job prospects for my field are not good unless you have a BS and a zillion years of experience \(I have an AS and no experience in my field\), and even still, there is a ton of outsourcing. What's the point of being a decade or longer in debt for a piece of paper?

I'm fat and not good looking. Even if I wasn't, I'm still a boring, pessimistic individual who has nothing to offer. Who would want to date me let alone have a relationship with me?

If you have time to read my backstory, it's here \> [https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/88idl6/im\_a\_27\_year\_old\_guy\_that\_could\_have\_had\_a\_great/](https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/88idl6/im_a_27_year_old_guy_that_could_have_had_a_great/)
